name: Mayagüez (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green hoist charged with a wide red cross fimbriated in white between four red flames, and a white fly with blue wavy stripes for the Yagüez River and the Mona Passage.
history: Mayagüez is a city and municipality on the western coast of Puerto Rico. The wide cross represents Christianity brought to the New World by Columbus, whose motto Christo Ferens the city bears; the waves recall the arms granted to Columbus and the Yagüez River of the City of Pure Waters. The flag was officially adopted by City Ordinance 38 signed on 3 December 1996, replacing arms designed in 1963.

features.role: wavy stripes for the Yagüez River
